releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.3 — Message Reactions Sync, 'Notify Once' Policy, Discrete Calls, and Contact Profile Hub
releaseNotes:
• Message Reactions Sync: Real-time synchronization of heart emoji (❤️) and emoji reactions across sender and receiver devices via Phoenix WebSockets, PostgreSQL JSONB storage, and local disk cache persistence.
• 'Notify Once Until Read' Notification Policy: Strictly alerts on the first incoming message. Subsequent messages sent while unread remain completely silent without repeated notification disturbance until the chat is opened.
• Discrete Call Notifications ('Don't Ring the Bell'): Replaced continuous telephone ringtone bell with a gentle notification chime and vibration (identical to message alerts) on a dedicated channel.
• WhatsApp/Telegram-style Contact Profile: Tapping avatar or contact header opens a full Contact Details sheet with quick actions (Audio/Video Call, Mute, Search in Chat, Disappearing Timer, Clear Chat, Block Contact).
• Shared Media, Links & Documents Hub: Tabbed browser inside the Contact Details sheet to inspect all shared photos/videos in a thumbnail grid, shared documents/files, and web links extracted from the conversation.
